title: Let the host settle a begun turn whose session it can no longer authenticate (orphaned begun grant)
outcome: A begun-but-unsettled turn grant can always be settled through a supported, audited host path, even when the host has lost the session's routing credentials, so no store needs a manual edit and doctor's open-turn warning can clear.
acceptance: A host-only operation, given a session id, a grant id, a reason and an idempotency key but no routing or connection token, settles a grant in state begun: the grant becomes completed, the session exits, and one turn checkpoint event attributed to the host actor records it with no execution evidence; an exact repeat replays, and a grant in any other state is refused with its current state
The settlement reuses existing record kinds, grant states and control operation names, so a store holding one passes doctor on the build before this change
The settlement grants no authority: it issues no grant, changes no claim or work binding, records no evidence, and the next turn in any session is evaluated against fresh epochs and fences
disposal_reason: Obsolete on Greg's word (Asistant #239): turn grants are gone, w-5b17f50b5079 sealed 9a697f91, so no begun grant can need settling.
